name: plugin.symbolic_solver
description: Neuro-symbolic constraint solver, safe arithmetic evaluation, and Horn-clause rule engine
author: Brain Harness Forge Engine

entrypoints.name: evaluate_math_expression
entrypoints.description: Safely evaluate mathematical and logic expressions without eval() vulnerability

parameters.name: expression
parameters.description: Mathematical formula to parse and evaluate (e.g. 'sqrt(16) * 4 + 2^3')

entrypoints.name: solve_constraints
entrypoints.description: Find satisfiable assignments for variables across a set of mathematical constraints

parameters.name: constraints
parameters.description: List of boolean expression constraints (e.g. ['x + y == 10', 'x > y'])

entrypoints.name: verify_logic_query
entrypoints.description: Verify whether a query statement holds given known facts and deduction rules
